name: Aisyah binti Rahman
bio:
Aisyah's journey into the high-octane world of Formula 1 was unexpected. Starting in her family's restaurant in Kuala Lumpur, she honed her culinary and management skills, catering to a diverse clientele. A chance encounter with a Red Bull Racing engineer during a promotional event ignited her interest in motorsport. Impressed by her organizational skills and ability to handle pressure, he recommended her for a catering management position within the team.

Aisyah believes that a well-fed team is a winning team. She meticulously plans menus, ensuring that the drivers and crew receive nutritious and delicious meals tailored to their individual needs. Her calm demeanor and resourcefulness ensure smooth operations, even amidst the chaotic atmosphere of race weekends. Aisyah's commitment to providing a taste of home for the team, no matter where they are in the world, makes her an invaluable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aisyah is of average height with a warm, friendly smile and a no-nonsense attitude.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down recipes and dietary requirements.
Insists on sourcing local ingredients whenever possible, even when traveling internationally.
Quietly judges the spice level of all the food she encounters.
